quiz_title: Web Design Advanced - Quiz 5: JS Arrays & Functions

questions.q: What is the index position of the very first item in a JavaScript array?
questions.exp: JavaScript arrays are zero-indexed! The first list item sits at colors[0].

questions.q: Which array method adds a new element to the END of the list?
questions.exp: push() appends items to list ends, while pop() removes the last element!

questions.q: How do you check how many items live inside an array named 'hobbies'?
questions.exp: The 'length' property returns the count of items currently stored inside arrays.

questions.q: What keyword outputs values from a function back to the caller?
questions.exp: The 'return' keyword halts functions and outputs calculations back to calls!

questions.q: Which property gets the text currently typed inside an input text box?
questions.exp: The '.value' property gets or sets current text strings typed in interactive inputs!
